sentences.en: In all likelihood, the president will serve a second term.
In all likelihood, we shall be away for a few days.
sentences.zh: 很有可能我们会离开几天。

sentences.en: In all likelihood, they'll be away for a week.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能要走一个星期。

senses.zh: 可能，可能性,数似然，似真

mnemonic: 联想记忆：likeli（看作likely，很可能）+ hood（表性质）→可能性
